prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization’s size, services, budget, goals, and whether you need deep healthcare/regulatory experience or more general digital/creative work. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a targeted recommendation:

Quick questions
- What type of healthcare organization are you (hospital system, specialty clinic, physician group, med device, biotech, payer, telehealth, other)?
- Primary goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, provider recruitment, product launch, physician referrals, internal communications, retention, etc.)?
- Services you need (strategic planning, branding, website, SEO, paid media, content, PR, creative, video, analytics, CRM, patient experience)?
- Annual marketing budget (ballpark)?
- Timeline (ongoing partner vs. 3–6 month campaign)?
- Must-haves (HIPAA experience, Medicare/Medicaid knowledge, local connections, Spanish language, underserved communities, bilingual outreach)?

If you prefer an immediate, practical next step, I can:
- Produce a curated shortlist of 4–6 St. Louis agencies that match your needs, with pros/cons and sample case studies to request.
- Provide an RFP template and interview questions tailored to healthcare.
- Compare 2–3 agencies side-by-side if you already have finalists.

Useful criteria to evaluate agencies (so you can judge “best” for you)
- Healthcare experience and regulatory understanding (HIPAA, FDA, patient privacy, claims language)
- Relevant case studies and measurable outcomes (patient volume, conversion rates, ROI)
- Integrated capabilities (strategy + creative + digital + analytics) vs. specialty shops
- Local market knowledge and connections to referral networks, media, and community partners
- Data/analytics and ability to tie campaigns to outcomes (appointments, revenue)
- Team seniority and availability (who will actually do the work)
- Transparency on pricing, reporting cadence, and KPIs
- Client retention and references

Sample interview questions to ask agencies
1. What healthcare clients have you worked with in St. Louis or similar markets? Can you share outcomes?
2. How do you measure patient acquisition and tie activity to ROI?
3. How do you handle HIPAA and patient data security in campaigns?
4. What channels do you recommend for reaching our patient demographic and why?
5. Who will be on our account and how much senior involvement can we expect?
6. Can you show an example campaign and the metrics you reported?
7. What is your typical contract length and billing model?
8. How do you manage creative approvals and compliance review cycles?
9. What tools/platforms do you use for analytics, CRM, and paid media?
10. Can you provide 2–3 client references with similar objectives?

Next step
Tell me the answers to the quick questions above (or say “I want a shortlist now”) and I’ll create a tailored shortlist and comparison along with an RFP and interview guide.
